natural_speed_note: the lab measures foot plants from the TOE bones; r7_metrics.json measures deformed sole vertices (walk 0.358 m/s, run 1.627 m/s). They differ (walk 22 %) because the toe bone leaves the floor earlier than the sole patch; run agrees within 1 %. clips.json records both; the lab value is what the lab sets as playback speed.
